mechanism: Primidone induces CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP3A4 and CYP2D6), reducing fluphenazine metabolism and increasing its serum levels, while fluphenazine may increase primidone levels; additive CNS depression also occurs.
action: Monitor for increased fluphenazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation) and primidone toxicity; may require fluphenazine dose adjustment or increased therapeutic drug monitoring if available.
